title: Emergency Management and Homeland Security - Emergency Medical Services
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: Emergency Management and Homeland Security - Emergency Medical Services - Associate of Science Degree and Certificate of Achievement - MAS1088/C/MCE1088
outcomes: Recognize the types of natural, manmade, and technological hazards that can negatively impact a community.
Compare and contrast various forms of National and International Terrorism.
Distinguish the fundamental roles and responsibilities of the professional emergency manager.
Demonstrate skills necessary to prepare for, mitigate, respond to, and recover from manmade and natural disasters.
Demonstrate the skills necessary to function in the EMS branch of the Incident Command System.

notes: The page prints one combined section for the Associate of Science Degree and the Certificate of Achievement; the single Program Requirements list (21 units) and the single Program Learning Outcomes list are shared by both awards and are recorded here for the certificate.

The heading is printed three times; the third instance carries different program codes (MAS1016/MAS1016/MAS1016C/MCE1016) than the first two (MAS1088/C/MCE1088). Reviewer may want to confirm which code set applies to this certificate.
Closed list stores EMS50 (no space, units not stored); catalog prints EMS-50 with 5.00 units. Treated as the same course, not a catalog addition.
Catalog prints codes with hyphens (HLS-1, EMS-51); these match closed-list codes HLS 1, EMS 51, etc.
